card.name: Start of the word contraindication
card.fires_on: The first piece "contr" of contraindication or contraindicated, right after "is a", "are", "not a" or "except when". It appears in drug-label sentences about when a drug should not be used.

modes.label: After a or not a
modes.description: Starts "contraindication" after the article, often in the phrase "is not a".
modes.example: the presence of these conditions is not a<< contr>>aindication to epinephrine

modes.label: After is, are or when
modes.description: Starts "contraindicated" or "contraindications" directly after a verb or conjunction.

card.writes: It pushes the model to write the word piece "contr" (as in contra-), so the word contraindication gets completed.
card.plain: It fires when the text is about to say "contraindication" or "contraindicated" in a drug label.
